definitions.explanation: A decorative design on fabric, paper, or other surfaces.
The size and shape of a person's body.
A person's typical behavior or personality.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}{柄|がら}のワンピース
{彼|かれ}は{柄|がら}が{大|おお}きい。
そんなことは{私|わたし}の{柄|がら}じゃない。
この{着物|きもの}は{柄|がら}がとても{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The pattern on this kimono is very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}な{柄|がら}のシャツは{仕事|しごと}には{向|む}かない。
examples.english: A shirt with a flashy pattern is not suitable for work.

examples.japanese: {柄|がら}の{小|ちい}さい{人|ひと}が{大|おお}きなスーツケースを{運|はこ}んでいた。
examples.english: A person of small build was carrying a large suitcase.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{柄|がら}が{大|おお}きいので、{電車|でんしゃ}の{席|せき}が{狭|せま}そうだ。
examples.english: My father has a large build, so train seats seem cramped for him.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{柄|がら}がいいので、みんなに{好|す}かれている。
examples.english: She has a good character, so everyone likes her.

examples.japanese: {嘘|うそ}をつくのは{彼|かれ}の{柄|がら}に{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: Telling lies does not suit his character.

notes:
{柄|がら} has multiple related meanings around pattern, build, and character.

SENSE 1 - PATTERN:
- {花|はな}{柄|がら} (floral pattern)
- {縞|しま}{柄|がら} (striped pattern)
- {水玉|みずたま}{柄|がら} (polka dot pattern)
- {無地|むじ} (no pattern, solid)

SENSE 2 - BUILD:
- {柄|がら}が{大|おお}きい (large build)
- {小柄|こがら} (small build)
- {大柄|おおがら} (large build)

SENSE 3 - CHARACTER:
- 〜{柄|がら}じゃない (not like one's character)
- 〜にも{似合|にあ}わぬ{柄|がら} (uncharacteristic of ~)
- {人柄|ひとがら} (personality, character)

OTHER READING:
- {柄|え} = handle (different reading)
